The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d3ecf115570d0b89), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The system P has rank five and a split nondegenerate trace pairing. Conjugation induces a surjective morphism GSp4 −→ SO(P) with scalar kernel. Its restriction to Sp4 is the spin covering, with kernel {1, −1}, and P is absolutely irreducible. For every odd prime ℓ, the lattice Λℓ = {D ∈ EndZℓ (TℓAt) : D† = D, Tr(D) = 0} (3.4) is free of rank five with unimodular trace pairing. If At is isogenous to the square of a non-CM elliptic curve, then Ft = End0 (At) ∩ Pt (3.5) is a rational two-dimensional plane on which the trace pairing is positive definite. Here the intersection denotes Hodge endomorphisms in the Betti realization, equivalently actual rational endomorphisms in every realization.
